recommended_discriminating_test: Compare both orders at matched loudness on the actual source.
what_determines_which_applies: Use before when detector/envelope should react to the changed tone; use after when tonal shaping should not alter compressor behavior.

recommended_discriminating_test: Exaggerate attack while matching gain reduction, then back off.
what_determines_which_applies: Source transients, desired envelope, circuit behavior, and downstream role determine the choice.

recommended_discriminating_test: Watch and hear recovery across repeated events.
what_determines_which_applies: Tempo, event spacing, sustain, and detector behavior determine whether recovery chatters or lingers.

recommended_discriminating_test: Match total gain reduction and output.
what_determines_which_applies: One stage is simpler; two stages may separate peak control from leveling but add cumulative coloration/flattening.

recommended_discriminating_test: A/B a phrase ride before versus after compression.
what_determines_which_applies: Macro placement and micro envelope are different tasks; order depends on which should drive the detector.

recommended_discriminating_test: Verify one dry path and match blend.
what_determines_which_applies: Routing flexibility, phase, sends, and workflow differ; both can work when dry paths are understood.

recommended_discriminating_test: Compare preserved alternatives.
what_determines_which_applies: Mixing into it integrates behavior; adding late exposes existing balance but may disrupt it.

recommended_discriminating_test: Match target band/reduction and compare collateral movement.
what_determines_which_applies: Crossovers, bandwidth, detector, and desired surrounding-band movement differ.

recommended_discriminating_test: Bypass each scope separately.
what_determines_which_applies: Individual control solves source variability; bus control creates group movement and can compound processing.

recommended_discriminating_test: Compare clarity, groove, and tone.
what_determines_which_applies: Full-band movement may feel rhythmic; band-limited control preserves tone but adds complexity.

recommended_discriminating_test: Create equivalent section states and compare.
what_determines_which_applies: Workflow preference and source material determine which reveals roles fastest.

recommended_discriminating_test: Remove the bridge in an alternative and assess attention/meaning.
what_determines_which_applies: Genre convention and narrative/repetition needs matter more than a rule.

position_a: Add layers for a bigger chorus
position_b: Remove before the chorus for contrast
recommended_discriminating_test: Level-match and compare pre-arrival subtraction versus chorus addition.
what_determines_which_applies: Absolute density and relative arrival both matter.

recommended_discriminating_test: A/B timing ranges in context.
what_determines_which_applies: Clarity/style versus width/human energy determine alignment.

recommended_discriminating_test: Compare one-bar addition/removal.
what_determines_which_applies: Convention supports expectation; phrase completeness may require asymmetry.

recommended_discriminating_test: Map roles and translate with different sounds.
what_determines_which_applies: Function mapping can teach pacing without copying surface identity.

recommended_discriminating_test: Mute one layer for a full section.
what_determines_which_applies: Genre, hook strength, and intended energy determine useful density.

recommended_discriminating_test: Mute generic effect and test one musical cue.
what_determines_which_applies: Effects offer explicit cues; motif/rhythm/silence may feel more specific.

recommended_discriminating_test: Mute/level-test each source and process the causal/supporting one.
what_determines_which_applies: The source that already sounds correct alone should often be preserved; context decides.

recommended_discriminating_test: Level-match equivalent small moves.
what_determines_which_applies: Headroom, phase, tone, and role determine whether attenuation or emphasis is cleaner.

recommended_discriminating_test: Bypass all and reintroduce only beneficial filters.
what_determines_which_applies: Routine cleanup may reduce accumulation; automatic filters can remove body and change phase.

recommended_discriminating_test: Compare tone between events.
what_determines_which_applies: Constant versus intermittent conflict determines whether permanent or conditional space is appropriate.

recommended_discriminating_test: Revoice/mute before a matched EQ A/B.
what_determines_which_applies: Structural conflicts deserve structural tests; small mix shaping can still be practical.

recommended_discriminating_test: Check mono after panning.
what_determines_which_applies: Stereo separation helps localization; mono and center energy still matter.

recommended_discriminating_test: Audition role-swapped sound/voicing alternatives.
what_determines_which_applies: Genre, sounds, pitch, envelope, and playback targets decide roles.

recommended_discriminating_test: Check stems and multiple sections.
what_determines_which_applies: Global imbalance may need broad mastering EQ; localized causes should be repaired smaller-scope.

recommended_discriminating_test: Use suggestions at reduced amount and compare blind.
what_determines_which_applies: Tools can surface candidates; automatic similarity/space can overfit and obscure intent.

recommended_discriminating_test: Compare broad static and conditional support-source attenuation.
what_determines_which_applies: Fixed holes are simple but voice/notes/arrangement vary.

recommended_discriminating_test: Check correlation/mono and narrow only the unstable band.
what_determines_which_applies: Mono stability versus spatial character depends on phase, playback, and role.

recommended_discriminating_test: Use chart after hearing/locating the real issue.
what_determines_which_applies: Charts can orient terminology but cannot prescribe actual recordings.

recommended_discriminating_test: Small fader A/B before EQ.
what_determines_which_applies: Hierarchy often solves audibility; tonal masking may remain after level is right.

recommended_discriminating_test: Filter only the tail regions causing buildup.
what_determines_which_applies: Clarity versus realism/warmth depends on return role and decay.

recommended_discriminating_test: Test arrangement dimensions before EQ.
what_determines_which_applies: Spectral shaping may help, but performance and placement may preserve natural tone better.

recommended_discriminating_test: Match perceived clarity and compare artifacts.
what_determines_which_applies: Targeted control preserves other bands; simple ducking may sound more coherent/rhythmic.

recommended_discriminating_test: Level-match and map roles first.
what_determines_which_applies: Average spectrum ignores source/form differences.

recommended_discriminating_test: Use context for decision and solo briefly for diagnosis.
what_determines_which_applies: Solo reveals artifacts; context determines role and masking.
